projects.name: PD-1 Nanobody Binder Discovery
projects.description: Construct and screen a synthetic VHH phage-display library to identify nanobody binders against human PD-1 extracellular domain. Includes biopanning, phage ELISA, clone picking, sequencing, and preliminary affinity ranking.

projects.name: PD-L1 Blocking Clone Validation
projects.description: Validate previously identified anti–PD-L1 nanobody clones for blocking activity using cell-based binding assays and competition experiments. Compare expression yield, purity, and functional inhibition across top candidates.

projects.name: CD19 CAR Binder Optimization
projects.description: Optimize CD19-binding antibody fragments for improved expression, thermal stability, and binding signal. Includes mutagenesis design, small-scale expression, purification, and BLI-based screening.

projects.name: SUMO Protease Activity Probe Development
projects.description: Design and test covalent or activity-based probes for SUMO protease labeling. Work includes probe synthesis planning, protein expression, labeling assays, SDS-PAGE analysis, and LC-MS confirmation.

projects.name: ncAA Incorporation in sfGFP Reporter
projects.description: Evaluate noncanonical amino acid incorporation efficiency in an sfGFP amber suppression reporter system using engineered tRNA/synthetase pairs. Measure fluorescence rescue, background readthrough, and expression conditions.

EGFR transcript fold-change: LNP-A 1.0x, LNP-B 2.6x, LNP-C 3.1x.

Final product EGFRd-PROTAC-001 isolated at 43% yield and 96% LCMS purity.
